opening.argument: The speaker says the refund was received but forgiveness was not approved, and the loan remains owed. The proposed strategy is to hold the refund in a high-yield savings account so the funds remain available if the debt must be repaid. This is presented through the creators' own experience, not as a guaranteed wealth scheme. The CIT Bank recommendation and description link are a financial-product promotion, accompanied by a disclosure that some links may earn the channel a commission. The repayment warning is central to the account, not an afterthought.

citations.quote: In this video I will share my wife and I's process for applying for a refund slash loan forgiveness
i only receive the refund not the forgiveness part so technically the twenty thousand dollars is still owed as of right now
Let's say Biden's loan forgiveness doesn't go through I'd still be able to quickly pull the funds out and pay off the debt
Make sure to NOT SPEND IT because the forgiveness portion hasn't been approved, so you may need to pay it back.
